observations: Three black projectors stacked vertically on a wooden surface.

Photo 1 shows the rear view: all three have 'InFocus' branding, DLP and HDMI logos, and multiple ports including HDMI, VGA, RS-232, USB-B, audio, and power.

All three have barcodes and serial numbers visible on the rear, but the model numbers are not clearly readable.
The top two projectors have 'InFocus IN119HDx' written on the rear panel in the seller's text, but this is not visible in the photos.
The background shows shelves with boxes labeled 'Acer Projector' and 'Projection Ceiling Mount'.
